phases.name: Binding blueprint and enforcement
phases.objective: Bind the current AppCare scope and phase governance to protected enforcement.
phases.runtime_wiring: CI parses the scope contract and blueprint contract; no customer capability is enabled.
phases.security_requirements: Protected review, no credentials or customer data, fail-closed readiness, and no production mutation.
phases.live_reference_evidence: None; this phase accepts governance evidence only.
phases.maturity_effect: BLUEPRINT_GOVERNANCE_MATURITY may reach SERVICE_READY only for governance enforcement.
phases.readiness_effect: Promote no CONNECT, INVENTORY, customer, pilot, paid-service, or production capability.

phases.name: Credential custody and SSH onboarding
phases.objective: Provide encrypted, scoped, revocable SSH credential custody and safe onboarding.
phases.runtime_wiring: Credential references resolve only at the Linux SSH boundary and bootstrap uses fixed typed operations with durable audit state.
phases.security_requirements: No plaintext secret persistence, non-root identity, tenant binding, strict ownership and modes, no arbitrary root shell, and fail-closed revocation.
phases.live_reference_evidence: Approved internal target may provide bounded onboarding evidence; no customer production write is implied.
phases.maturity_effect: Custody and onboarding components advance only to the highest evidence-backed maturity level.
phases.readiness_effect: Credential rotation, offboarding, and stack readiness remain unpromoted until their evidence passes.

phases.name: Live CONNECT, INVENTORY, and immutable baseline
phases.objective: Establish trusted live target identity, normalized inventory, and immutable application baseline.
phases.runtime_wiring: Spec 014 transport and Spec 013 capability/evidence evaluators consume one tenant/application target identity.
phases.security_requirements: Strict host-key verification, non-root read-only access, path and output limits, no TOFU, and no automatic privilege escalation.
phases.live_reference_evidence: Qualifying real-target CONNECT, INVENTORY, and immutable revision evidence is required; fixtures remain non-live.
phases.maturity_effect: Linux transport and inventory advance only when live evidence is independently accepted.
phases.readiness_effect: Only exact-target CONNECT and INVENTORY may be promoted; downstream capabilities remain missing.

phases.name: Streaming filesystem backup and data classification
phases.objective: Capture a real target filesystem through bounded streaming with explicit data classification.
phases.runtime_wiring: The filesystem source feeds the existing AppCare backup manifest and restore pipeline without a second backup system.
phases.security_requirements: Tenant roots, symlink and special-file controls, secret exclusion, resource caps, immutable metadata, and no production overwrite.
phases.live_reference_evidence: Real-target filesystem evidence is required for LIVE_VERIFIED; fixture/reference archives cannot promote readiness.
phases.maturity_effect: Filesystem backup advances only after bounded streaming, manifest, checksum, and isolated restore evidence pass.
phases.readiness_effect: No off-site or whole-application recovery claim until P06 remote readback and restore complete.

phases.name: Live MariaDB/MySQL transport and isolated database restore
phases.objective: Prove a bounded MariaDB/MySQL logical backup and isolated restore for the approved database.
phases.runtime_wiring: Spec 015 adapters feed the existing AppCare backup pipeline and Spec 013 evidence registry with exact target binding.
phases.security_requirements: Closed commands, no arbitrary SQL, no secret argv or logs, consistency limitations, timeout/cancel, tenant isolation, and non-production restore only.
phases.live_reference_evidence: Qualifying real-target database evidence is required for LIVE_VERIFIED; fixtures and isolated references remain non-live.
phases.maturity_effect: Database adapter maturity advances only after exact engine, scope, integrity, and restore evidence pass.
phases.readiness_effect: Database capability alone cannot promote whole-application backup, restore, or customer readiness.

phases.name: B2, Glacier, and complete application restore
phases.objective: Join verified filesystem and database components into immutable off-site recovery and complete isolated restore evidence.
phases.runtime_wiring: The canonical AppCare backup boundary feeds approved provider wrappers and isolated restore only.
phases.security_requirements: Least-privilege provider scope, immutable retention, remote readback, checksum binding, secret-safe evidence, and no production restore.
phases.live_reference_evidence: Provider-controlled or real-target off-site evidence must be independently proven; local snapshots are not authoritative.
phases.maturity_effect: Off-site and complete-restore components advance only after provider and isolated-recovery receipts pass.
phases.readiness_effect: No deploy or pilot readiness without a verified application recovery point and rehearsal.

phases.name: Live security scanning and test discovery
phases.objective: Execute allowlisted scanners and discover tests safely against the verified application scope.
phases.runtime_wiring: Scanner and test-discovery results flow through AppCare workflow and evidence models and cannot authorize remediation or production.
phases.security_requirements: No arbitrary executable, config, network, or inherited secrets; bounded resources/output; tenant path scope; sanitized findings.
phases.live_reference_evidence: Real-target scan and test-discovery evidence is required for LIVE_VERIFIED; reference scans remain non-live.
phases.maturity_effect: Scanner and test-discovery components advance only with bounded live evidence and independent security review.
phases.readiness_effect: Findings do not imply a permitted fix or production action; staging and remediation remain P08 work.

phases.name: Brownfield normalization, staging, and remediation
phases.objective: Normalize brownfield state and perform remediation only in an isolated staging workflow.
phases.runtime_wiring: Normalized artifacts feed the existing staging and remediation workflow with exact source, data, and approval bindings.
phases.security_requirements: No production-first edits, tenant isolation, deterministic patches, secret-safe staging, backup-before-change, and rollback preparation.
phases.live_reference_evidence: Real-target normalization and verified preproduction evidence are required for LIVE_VERIFIED; synthetic staging is insufficient.
phases.maturity_effect: Normalization, staging, and remediation advance independently to the highest accepted evidence level.
phases.readiness_effect: No deployment or customer-onboarding promotion without exact preproduction evidence and rollback-ready artifact.

phases.name: Deployment, migration safety, verification, and rollback
phases.objective: Execute exact-artifact deployment with migration safety, verification, and automatic rollback.
phases.runtime_wiring: Deployment is reachable only through the durable AppCare workflow using the approved artifact, verification, and automatic rollback after authoritative preproduction and application-scoped approval.
phases.security_requirements: Immutable intent, exact revision and digest binding, explicit approval, no arbitrary commands, data-loss analysis, rollback reference, duplicate prevention, and fail-closed verification.
phases.live_reference_evidence: Qualifying controlled or real-target deployment and rollback evidence is required; fixtures cannot certify customer service.
phases.maturity_effect: Deployment and rollback advance only together with exact identity and verification evidence.
phases.readiness_effect: No pilot readiness from staging success alone and no production promotion without rollback; global live production remains disabled.

phases.name: Monitoring, scheduler, alerting, reporting, and support tiers
phases.objective: Provide durable monitoring, scheduling, alerting, reporting, and support operations.
phases.runtime_wiring: Monitoring state persists in the PostgreSQL-backed AppCare database and is consumed by dashboard and reporting surfaces after restart.
phases.security_requirements: Tenant-scoped collectors, bounded polling and resource quotas, alert deduplication, no secret leakage, worker leases, and durable replay safety.
phases.live_reference_evidence: Sustained controlled or real-target monitoring and alert/report delivery are required for LIVE_VERIFIED.
phases.maturity_effect: Monitoring and operations advance only after persisted restart-safe evidence, not in-memory observations.
phases.readiness_effect: No paid-service readiness without sustained operations, support workflow, and cost evidence.

phases.name: Operator productization, commercial lifecycle, offboarding, and AppCare DR
phases.objective: Operator productization, commercial lifecycle, offboarding, and AppCare DR/self-recovery.
phases.runtime_wiring: Operator and customer state, support tiers, approvals, billing, credentials, offboarding, reports, and DR evidence are persisted and auditable.
phases.security_requirements: Least privilege, tenant isolation, external secret custody (secret-manager custody), approval separation, recovery/offboarding proof, restart durability, and no global production switch.
phases.live_reference_evidence: External-beta service readiness requires qualifying real operational, service-ready evidence; reference product flows remain insufficient.
phases.maturity_effect: Complete operations and operator/commercial components advance only after durable live workflow and recovery evidence.
phases.readiness_effect: Paid-service and customer onboarding readiness remains blocked until all dependencies and external secret custody pass.

phases.name: Real-target acceptance, exact-release security review, and beta decision
phases.objective: Complete the real-target lifecycle, real cost measurement, exact-release S01-S30 review, and evidence-backed beta decision.
phases.runtime_wiring: The evaluator consumes all predecessor and exact-head/exact-scope persisted evidence for the decision and cannot be enabled by a caller boolean, worker claim, or stale receipt.
phases.security_requirements: All mandatory S01-S30 gates, real-target cost, rotation/offboarding, restart durability, reporting, rollback, and production-disable invariants must pass fail-closed.
phases.live_reference_evidence: One real internal application must complete the applicable lifecycle; synthetic/reference evidence remains insufficient, and external beta requires owner-authorized exact real-target evidence.
phases.maturity_effect: Only exact evidence-backed layers may advance; documentation and fixtures cannot become SERVICE_READY.
phases.readiness_effect: Decide PRIVATE_BETA customer, pilot, and paid readiness only after predecessor gates and owner-authorized production evidence; global production stays disabled with LIVE_CUSTOMER_PRODUCTION_ENABLED=NO.
